module: Console unit tests for mathlib's vec3 type: correctness (constructor, tostring, operators + - * / and unary, equality) and performance (100001 iterations of the four operations). Both tests are launched on import.
notes: The precision test expects vec3(0,133007.133,-1) to be displayed as "(0, 133007.141, -1)", which shows a loss of floating-point precision at large values.
test_vec3_performance uses the globals a and b left by test_vec3_function; it logs a warning if the duration exceeds 850 ms.
The assertions raise a Lua error if a test fails.

test_vec3_function.desc: Checks with assert the vec3 constructors, display (tostring) and operators.

test_vec3_performance.desc: Times 100001 loops of vec3 addition, subtraction, multiplication and division and logs a warning (level D) beyond 850 ms.
